# Official MCP Apps Quickstart

`server.ts`, `mcp-app.html`, and `src/mcp-app.ts` are byte-for-byte copies of the [Quickstart at v1.7.5](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/ext-apps/tree/92f46a574568a3ddac7600343b7d3c4c4ed7b588/examples/quickstart). The upstream example package declares MIT and the upstream project records a licensing transition in [LICENSE](LICENSE), reproduced in full here.

`stdio.ts` and `vite.config.ts` are Lab entry points for the upstream server factory and a self-contained resource build.
